description: Pronto port-E rig (qualification/render-qualification-program.v1.json: 8 cameras x RGB/depth/instance-ID/semantic, 6 lidars, 4 radars, plus the trailing chase camera) mounted on the ego of a one-tick scene state over the WSB1 decoded corpus tiles, through `simforge-render job` rig.pronto. The scene state (fixtures/yale-pronto.scene-state.json) is run/evidence/scene-state.v1.json as a service stream: schema id simforge.scene-state.v1, spawn records, and the retired capture binary's class-default cuboid extents as dims; its generic catalog ids render as class cuboids (allowPrimitiveActors, as the retired capture binary drew them). Not ported: the retired capture binary's IMU/GNSS samples (--xodr georeference); the job has no IMU/GNSS output. No frame-time gate (one tick).
